run_test_units_details_view: run the TestUnitsDetailsView unit tests to verify the units_details API endpoint behavior
test_no_arguments_error: test that the units_details endpoint returns a 400 error when no unit_ids parameter is provided
test_parsing_arguments_error: test that the units_details endpoint returns a 400 error when unit_ids is not a comma-separated list of integers
test_no_units_success: test that the units_details endpoint returns an empty units list when a non-existent unit_id is requested
test_one_unit_success: test that the units_details endpoint returns correct unit data including metadata and worker_reviews for a valid unit
